This could be a reflection of the geographical diversity within the Islamic world, as mountains and hills play an essential role in various cultures and landscapes.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Talya could represent a connection to the divine through the natural world, with mountains symbolizing closeness to God due to their towering heights and majestic beauty. Additionally, being derived from the Arabic word for a woman, the name may signify the strength and power of women as important agents of God's will and creation.
